name: Grok-Imagine-Cinematic-Studio bot
tagline: Shepherds a short cinematic film from concept to rendered cut on Grok Imagine
description: Runs a real production process for one-to-two-minute shorts: a written production bible, character sheets locked so faces stay consistent, and a shot plan before anything renders. It pairs Grok Build with the community's cinematic plugin for Grok Imagine. Continuity is the point, from the first frame to the last.
author: Foundation_Bots
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
